title: Input indices as layer nodes
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and a finite list of gates. For a layer index $d$ satisfying $d\leq$ the number of gates and an index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n+d-1\}$, the corresponding node at layer $d$ is the node indexed by $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is at most the number of gates
